channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: A Diplomacy Alumna’s Lead in Human Rights Advocacy
item.description: Seton Hall diplomacy alumna leads human rights advocacy efforts. Her work focuses on promoting and protecting human rights, though specific details about her initiatives and impact are not provided. A Diplomacy Alumna’s Lead in Human Rights Advocacy Seton Hall.

item.title: Tehran Says It Is Discussing Plan With U.S. to End Hostilities
item.description: Iran will respond to a US peace proposal through Pakistan. An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official had earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”.

item.title: Former U.S. analyst, once jailed for spying for Israel, to run for Israeli parliament
item.description: Jonathan Pollard, a former US intelligence analyst, will run in the Israeli elections. He served 30 years for spying for Israel and now seeks a seat in the Israeli parliament.

item.title: ‘This is my last voice note’: how piracy returned to Somalia and Yemen
item.description: Three ships were hijacked near the Gulf of Aden, raising concerns about piracy returning to Somalia and Yemen. The incidents have sparked alarms over the safety of key sea routes.

item.title: US and Iran close to temporary truce, Pakistani officials claim
item.description: Pakistani officials claim the US and Iran are close to a temporary truce. The details of the agreement are not specified, but it is said to be a tentative arrangement.

item.title: Gulf states urge UN action to ensure Strait of Hormuz safety
item.description: Gulf states have urged the UN to take action to ensure the safety of the Strait of Hormuz. They have drafted a resolution demanding Iran to halt attacks and allow passage of humanitarian aid.

item.title: Trump Praises Meeting With Brazil's Lula At White House
item.description: US President Trump hosted Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva at the White House on Wednesday. The meeting marked a significant diplomatic engagement between the two nations. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva met President Trump on Wednesday at the White House.

item.title: Inside the Israeli bloc that could topple Netanyahu
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's rivals have formed an alliance ahead of elections. The coalition's strength remains uncertain, with analysts questioning its ability to unseat Netanyahu. Netanyahu’s rivals unite ahead of elections, but is this alliance strong enough to actually unseat him?

item.title: Israel’s attacks and pressure sowing seeds for division in tense Lebanon
item.description: Israel's military and political pressures on Lebanon are exacerbating divisions within the country. Analysts believe Israel aims to exploit these divisions to force concessions from Lebanon. Analysts say Israel aiming to exploit Lebanon’s divisions to force concessions amid military and political pressures.

item.title: US-proposed Iran resolution at UN faces likely vetoes from China, Russia
item.description: A US-proposed resolution on Iran at the UN faces likely vetoes from China and Russia. The resolution's passage is uncertain due to opposition from the two major veto-wielding nations. US-proposed Iran resolution at UN faces likely vetoes from China, Russia Reuters.

item.title: US sanctions Iraqi minister accused of aiding Iran oil sales
item.description: The US has imposed sanctions on Iraq's deputy oil minister, accusing him of aiding Iran in bypassing oil export restrictions. The sanctions target the minister's alleged role in facilitating Iran's oil sales.

item.title: Protests in Bolivia escalate amid economic turmoil and policy demands
item.description: Clashes erupted in La Paz as workers protest against rising fuel prices and damaged vehicles caused by subsidy cuts. The protests are part of a larger economic turmoil in Bolivia, with demonstrators demanding policy changes.

item.title: Mother of Jake Hall's child tells of 'devastating loss' after TOWIE star dies aged 35
item.description: The mother of Jake Hall's daughter spoke of their "devastating loss" after the reality star died at 35. Jake Hall was a star on the TV show TOWIE. The mother of reality star Jake Hall's daughter has spoken of their "devastating loss" after the TV star died at the age of 35.

item.title: Trump's 'irresponsible war' to blame for economic slowdown, German minister says
item.description: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil blamed US President Trump's "irresponsible war in Iran" for harming the German economy. Klingbeil cited the war as a reason for the economic slowdown. Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil blamed the US president's "irresponsible war in Iran" for harming the Germany economy.

item.title: Tornadoes cut across Mississippi as severe storms damage 500 homes
item.description: Severe storms swept across Mississippi, cutting through with tornadoes and damaging over 500 homes. The storms caused significant destruction in the region. Tornadoes cut across Mississippi as severe storms damage 500 homes.

item.title: US Imposes Sanctions On Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Over Support To Iran
item.description: The United States imposed sanctions on Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Ali Maarij al-Bahadly for allegedly helping Iran avoid sanctions and export oil through Iraq. The move is part of US efforts to restrict Iran's oil exports.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal as Trump pressures Tehran for agreement on deal to end war
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal for a deal to end the war as Trump pressures Tehran for an agreement. Tehran denies allegations its forces were behind a blast on a Panama-flagged ship.

item.title: Inside ‘hantavirus’ cruise ship where 3 died, others fell sick
item.description: A cruise ship was quarantined after three passengers died and others fell sick from hantavirus. The ship was isolated to prevent further spread of the virus. Inside ‘hantavirus’ cruise ship where 3 died, others fell sick.

item.title: Zelenskiy says Russian war commemoration ceasefire shows 'strange and inappropriate' logic
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy criticized Russia's proposed ceasefire during a war commemoration as having "strange and inappropriate" logic. Russia had suggested a temporary truce to mark a wartime event. Zelenskiy expressed skepticism over the move.

item.title: 1,500 Ships Trapped In Gulf Due To Iran's Hormuz Blockade: UN Maritime Body
item.description: Iran's Hormuz blockade trapped 1,500 ships in the Gulf. The closure has led to a significant global surge in the price of hydrocarbons. 1,500 Ships Trapped In Gulf Due To Iran's Hormuz Blockade: UN Maritime Body.
